description: This Java class 'MoneyHelperInitializationService' provides services to initialize and check the status of 'MoneyHelper' configurations for multi-tenant environments within the Apache Fineract platform. It reads configuration values, manages tenant context, and delegates to 'MoneyHelper' for tenant-specific financial rounding settings.

classes.name: MoneyHelperInitializationService
classes.description: A Spring service component for initializing and verifying tenant-specific MoneyHelper configurations based on system-wide or tenant-specific global settings.

methods.name: initializeTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Initializes MoneyHelper for the specified tenant by loading configuration settings and applying them. Sets and clears tenant context during the process.

methods.name: isTenantInitialized
methods.description: Checks whether MoneyHelper has been initialized for a given tenant identifier.

methods.name: getRoundingModeFromConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the rounding mode value from global configuration, defaulting to a configured value.
